tagline: Thank you for your purchase. Pick a colour theme below - your planner is two clicks away.
excel_note: Prefer Excel? The .xlsx files are included in your download and open in Excel 2016 or later.
steps: Sign in to your Google account, then click a button above and choose “Make a copy”. The copy is yours alone.
Open the Setup tab. Enter your budget year, how often you are paid, your first payday and your take-home pay.
Rename the starter categories, type a monthly amount for each, and give your bills a due day.
Log income and spending on the Transactions tab: date, category, amount.
Open the Dashboard, Paychecks and Bill Calendar tabs and pick a month or paycheck from the yellow dropdown.
tips: Yellow cells are yours to type in. Pale yellow cells are filled in for you and can be typed over.
Want to see it working first? Open a sample-data copy and explore.
On a phone or tablet, use the free Google Sheets app.
terms: For personal use by one household. Please do not share, resell or redistribute this file or its links.
support: Questions? Message the shop on Etsy and we will help.
